role: Layer 3 knowledge graph exception hierarchy for granular error handling
detail: Defines eight exception classes forming a hierarchy: KnowledgeGraphError (base for all Layer 3 errors), NodeNotFoundError (raised on node lookup failure, stores node_id), EdgeNotFoundError (raised on edge lookup failure, stores edge_id), SchemaViolationError (raised when graph operations violate schema invariants like INSTANCE_OF constraints or frozen bootstrap rules, stores invariant identifier and detail), BootstrapError (raised when META_SCHEMA initialization sequence fails), SchemaNotInitializedError (raised when Neo4j constraints/indexes missing, stores missing_constraints and missing_indexes lists), MigrationChecksumError (raised when applied migration file is modified after application, stores version/expected/actual SHA256 checksums), SimilarityError (raised in Epic 4 similarity pipeline when embedding vectors missing/mismatched), ExpectationError (raised in Epic 4 expectation verification pipeline when PropertyExpectation nodes malformed). All inherit from CoBeingError enabling layered exception catching. Module includes usage examples showing try/catch patterns and logging strategies.
gotchas: SimilarityError and ExpectationError have no custom __init__ (inherit from KnowledgeGraphError with no message formatting), so callers must construct messages; MigrationChecksumError couples to SHA256 hex digest format but no algorithm validation in class itself
